name: Appwrite Cloud Free
free_limit: Appwrite Cloud Free: 2 projects, 5 GB monthly bandwidth, 2 GB storage, 750,000 executions/month and 75,000 monthly active users
watch_out: Free includes one database, one bucket and two functions per project; projects pause after one week of inactivity. Backups, extra resources and production-oriented features require paid tiers; do not mistake the $10 Pro compute credit for Free recurring usage.
